text.p: Frontier Adjusters of America Inc said it expected a $525,000 settlement will cut its earnings by $0.07 per share for the fiscal year ended June 30.
A May 13 First Call estimate of one broker put Frontier's earnings at $0.08 a share for the quarter ended June 30 and $0.26 a share for the whole year.
Frontier said the settlement will result in a net income decrease of about $320,000 after taxes, or $0.07 a share.

The company said it agreed to the settlement with Mark Brockbank and Alan Bird, individually and on behalf of certain underwriters at Lloyds of London. The parties agreed to withdraw their allegations and claims in a Texas lawsuit against the company, Frontier added.
A company spokesman could not immediately elaborate on the suit's details and company officials were not immediately available for comment.

Frontier posted a net income of $265,000, or $0.06 a share, in the first quarter, compared with a net of $279,000, or $0.06 a share, the year before. Its stock closed at 2-9/16 Wednesday, close to its 52-week low of 2-1/2.
